2586-2921-4186.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat

147-1893-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-2438.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2033-3249-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

719-728-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-728-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

620-2111-3967.description:

When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3946-6701-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

215-1251-5614.description:

Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.

Repeat from step 1.

Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

4824-6287-7308.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.

4824-6287-7308.description:

Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.

539-3007-3899-4552-5902.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-5902.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.

When Glint Hawk enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Glint Hawk.

3967-4027-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

11-799-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-799-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Karn's Temporal Sundering from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

4053-5499-7060--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7060--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5189-5231-6584.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

1497-3327-4613-6461.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-6461.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

225-5226-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5226-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1741-1912-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}
1741-1912-4499.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

803-1486-1753-2872.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-1753-2872.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
803-1486-1753-2872.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

435-2292-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-167-2921.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

1741-3147-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1741-3147-5900.description:

Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Azorius Chancery and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

2167-4499-5531.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands, three of which are mana-producing.
2167-4499-5531.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land, adding one mana of any type that land can produce.
Repeat step 1 at least two more times, and more times if desired, ensuring to leave at least one land on the battlefield.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Lumra.
When Lumra enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2034-4316-5004-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cathodion on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Cathodion from the top of your library by paying {3}.
Repeat.

Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Composite Golem, targeting any creature.
Repeat.
